meta.prompt: Show me how the product did this month as an inline dashboard with a toggle between 7, 30 and 90 days that changes every number. Four stat tiles with their change, each period: 7 days: revenue $18.4k (+4.1%), sign-ups 312 (+6.0%), churn 2.9% (-0.2%), active users 13,870 (+1.4%); 30 days: $78.9k (+8.5%), 1,340 (+11.2%), 3.1% (+0.4%), 14,260 (+6.3%); 90 days: $221k (+15.3%), 3,905 (+9.8%), 3.4% (-0.6%), 14,260 (+12.1%). A line chart of revenue over the period, and a bar chart of sign-ups by channel (Organic, Paid, Referral, Social, Email) that adds up to the sign-ups: 7 days 128, 84, 52, 31, 17; 30 days 540, 372, 218, 134, 76; 90 days 1,580, 1,010, 640, 420, 255. Under them a table of the top five plans I can sort by any column, starting with revenue, highest first: Pro 1,340 subs, $38,900, churn 2.1%; Team 412, $24,700, 1.4%; Starter 2,980, $8,900, 5.2%; Business 96, $4,800, 0.9%; Student 640, $1,600, 6.8%.
meta.text:
state period="30"
state range="30 days"
state sort="revenue"
state desc=true
state plans=[{"plan":"Pro","subs":1340,"revenue":38900,"churn":2.1},{"plan":"Team","subs":412,"revenue":24700,"churn":1.4},{"plan":"Starter","subs":2980,"revenue":8900,"churn":5.2},{"plan":"Business","subs":96,"revenue":4800,"churn":0.9},{"plan":"Student","subs":640,"revenue":1600,"churn":6.8}]

let revenue = period=="7" ? "$18.4k" : period=="30" ? "$78.9k" : "$221k"
let revDelta = period=="7" ? "+4.1%" : period=="30" ? "+8.5%" : "+15.3%"
let signups = period=="7" ? "312" : period=="30" ? "1,340" : "3,905"
let signDelta = period=="7" ? "+6.0%" : period=="30" ? "+11.2%" : "+9.8%"
let churn = period=="7" ? "2.9%" : period=="30" ? "3.1%" : "3.4%"
let churnDelta = period=="7" ? "-0.2%" : period=="30" ? "+0.4%" : "-0.6%"
let active = period=="7" ? "13,870" : period=="30" ? "14,260" : "14,260"
let activeDelta = period=="7" ? "+1.4%" : period=="30" ? "+6.3%" : "+12.1%"
let revSeries = period=="7" ? [2.1,2.4,2.2,2.7,2.9,2.6,3.1] : period=="30" ? [2.2,2.5,2.4,2.7,2.9,2.8,3.0,3.2,3.1,3.4] : [1.9,2.1,2.4,2.6,2.8,3.0,3.3,3.5,3.4,3.8,4.0,4.2]
let chanValues = period=="7" ? [128,84,52,31,17] : period=="30" ? [540,372,218,134,76] : [1580,1010,640,420,255]
let chanLabels = ["Organic","Paid","Referral","Social","Email"]
let sorted = desc ? sortByDesc(plans, p => p[sort]) : sortBy(plans, p => p[sort])

Column gap:12 pad:12 w:390
  Row gap:8
    ChoiceChip "7 days" selected:{period=="7"} -> period="7"; range="7 days"
    ChoiceChip "30 days" selected:{period=="30"} -> period="30"; range="30 days"
    ChoiceChip "90 days" selected:{period=="90"} -> period="90"; range="90 days"
  Grid cols:2 gap:10
    StatTile "Revenue" "vs last period" "{revenue}" "{revDelta}"
    StatTile "Sign-ups" "vs last period" "{signups}" "{signDelta}"
    StatTile "Churn" "vs last period" "{churn}" "{churnDelta}" invert:true
    StatTile "Active users" "vs last period" "{active}" "{activeDelta}"
  ChartCard title:"Revenue" value:"{revenue}" values:revSeries kind:"line" delta:"{revDelta}" labels:["Start","","","","","","End"]
  ChartCard title:"Sign-ups by channel" value:"{signups}" values:chanValues kind:"bars" labels:chanLabels
  SectionLabel "Top plans" "{range}"
  TableHeader =sort desc:desc columns:["Plan","Subs","Revenue","Churn"] keys:["plan","subs","revenue","churn"]
  each p in sorted
    TableRow cells:[p.plan, fixed(p.subs,0), money(p.revenue,"$",0), fixed(p.churn,1)+"%"]
